rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) - Annual Allowable Rent Increase
rules.requirement: If your unit is covered by the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, your landlord can only raise rent by the annual allowable percentage set by the city each year, and must give advance written notice.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units covered by the City of Los Angeles RSO, generally properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28, including apartments, condos/townhomes (pre-1996 tenancies), duplexes, multiple single-family units on one parcel, long-term hotel/rooming house rooms, ADUs/JADUs, and mobile homes in mobile home parks.
rules.exemptions: Condominiums and townhomes are not rent-regulated for tenancies commencing after December 31, 1995.
rules.quoted_span:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
is
3%

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is a replacement unit under LAMC 151.28, or a condo/townhome where tenancy commenced after 12/31/1995

rules.title: RSO Overview - Coverage and allowable rent increase provisions
rules.requirement: The RSO sets rules for allowable rent increases, including conditions under which rent may be raised to market rate without LAHD approval, for covered rental properties in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.coverage_conditions: Generally applies to rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC Section 151.28, and various property types listed (apartments, condos, duplexes, etc.).
rules.exemptions: Condominiums and townhomes are not rent-regulated for tenancies commencing after December 31, 1995.
